apps.name: Gorgias
apps.summary: Ecommerce helpdesk priced by ticket volume (not seats), with a usage-priced AI Agent on every plan.
apps.ai_billing: Per automated interaction: $1.00 on monthly contracts, $0.90 on annual. Each AI interaction also counts as a helpdesk ticket. Gorgias's page also lists $1.50 per interaction for overage above a plan's included allowance.

plans.name: Starter
plans.includes: 50 tickets/mo, 30 AI interactions; $0.40/extra ticket; monthly billing only

plans.name: Advanced
plans.includes: 5,000 tickets/mo, 530 AI interactions; $0.36/extra ticket (sold via demo)

apps.free_alt: Shopify Inbox covers storefront chat and a basic AI agent for free, but not email ticketing.
apps.notes: Gorgias's pricing page markup also contains a second, higher price set (Basic $77, Pro $471, Advanced $1,227). We used the detailed plan data (tickets, overage, AI allowance) on the same page. Check your quote on gorgias.com.
apps.ai_short: $1.00 per automated interaction (monthly), plus ticket fees

apps.name: Tidio (Lyro AI Agent)
apps.summary: Live chat and helpdesk with Lyro, an AI agent sold as its own plan. Human and AI conversations are billed separately.
apps.ai_billing: Per Lyro conversation: any conversation with at least one Lyro reply counts once, whether or not it's resolved. Lyro plan: $39/mo for up to 200 Lyro conversations. Every account gets 50 Lyro conversations once.

plans.name: Free
plans.includes: Live chat with 50 users, Flows for up to 100 visitors/mo

plans.name: Customer Service (Growth)
plans.includes: From 250 billable conversations (higher tiers priced on Tidio's site)

plans.name: Lyro AI Agent
plans.includes: Up to 200 Lyro conversations; larger tiers: check site

plans.name: Flows
plans.includes: Automation flows for up to 40k visitors

apps.free_alt: Shopify Inbox's free AI agent overlaps with Lyro for pre-sales and FAQ chat.
apps.notes: The annual prices ($24.17, $49.17, $32.50) are monthly equivalents of yearly billing. The monthly prices are from Tidio's Shopify App Store listing.
apps.ai_short: Per Lyro conversation ($39 for 200), human chats billed separately

apps.name: Intercom (Fin AI Agent)
apps.summary: Seat-based helpdesk with Fin, an AI agent billed per outcome. Fin can also run on top of another helpdesk.
apps.ai_billing: $0.99 per Fin outcome. An outcome counts when the customer confirms it's resolved, doesn't ask for more help, or Fin completes a workflow, including handoffs. Charged once per conversation.

plans.name: Essential
plans.includes: Per seat. Fin, Messenger, shared inbox, help center

plans.name: Advanced
plans.includes: Per seat. Workflows, multiple inboxes, 20 free Lite seats

plans.name: Expert
plans.includes: Per seat. SSO, SLAs, multibrand, 50 free Lite seats

plans.name: Fin standalone
plans.includes: $0.99/outcome on your current helpdesk, no seats. A monthly minimum applies (e.g. 50 outcomes)

apps.notes: The monthly seat prices ($39/$99/$139) are from Intercom's Shopify App Store listing. The annual prices are from intercom.com. Optional add-ons: Copilot $29/agent/mo (annual), Pro $100/mo.
apps.ai_short: $0.99 per Fin outcome, plus per-seat fee

apps.name: Zendesk (AI agents)
apps.summary: Seat-based helpdesk. Every plan includes AI agents with a small allowance of automated resolutions, and usage beyond it is billed per resolution.
apps.ai_billing: Per automated resolution. Each plan includes 5 (Team plans) or 10 (Suite Professional) per agent per month. Beyond that, $1.50 each committed or $2.00 pay-as-you-go.

plans.name: Support Team
plans.includes: Per agent. Email ticketing, 5 automated resolutions/agent/mo

plans.name: Suite Team
plans.includes: Per agent. Messaging and live chat, AI agents, 5 automated resolutions/agent/mo

apps.notes: Zendesk's Shopify App Store listing still shows a Suite Growth plan ($89) and Suite Enterprise at $150. Those weren't on zendesk.com's pricing page on the check date.
apps.ai_short: $2.00 per automated resolution PAYG ($1.50 committed), plus seats

apps.name: HubSpot Service Hub (Customer Agent)
apps.summary: CRM-connected helpdesk. Its AI Customer Agent needs the Professional plan or higher and runs on HubSpot Credits.
apps.ai_billing: $0.50 per resolved conversation (50 HubSpot Credits). A resolution means the conversation wasn't handed to a human for 72 hours. Professional includes 3,000 credits/mo (about 60 resolutions if nothing else uses them).

plans.name: Free
plans.includes: Up to 2 users, shared inbox, basic live chat and bots. No Customer Agent

plans.name: Starter
plans.includes: Per seat. 500 credits. No Customer Agent

plans.name: Professional
plans.includes: Per seat. 3,000 credits, Customer Agent. $1,500 one-time onboarding

apps.notes: HubSpot's own pricing page didn't load its price data for us on the check date. Prices come from HubSpot's official Customer Agent page and its Service Hub pricing guide (updated 28 Aug 2026).
apps.ai_short: $0.50 per resolution via credits; Professional seats required

apps.name: Shopify Inbox
apps.summary: Shopify's own free chat app with an AI sales associate trained on your catalog, policies and store content.
apps.ai_billing: Free. No usage fee is listed on the App Store.

plans.name: Free
plans.includes: AI agent, live chat, email chat, order updates, analytics

apps.free_alt: This is the free Shopify option.
apps.notes: Covers storefront chat. It isn't a full email helpdesk (no shared ticket inbox for email, social and returns).
sources: Shopify Inbox on Shopify App Store

apps.name: Richpanel
apps.summary: Ecommerce helpdesk sold per seat, with AI billed on a token meter rather than per resolution.
apps.ai_billing: Token-based credits: $0.60/credit monthly or $0.50 annual. Richpanel says about $0.20 covers a whole AI-handled conversation at the annual rate. AI minimum is $200/mo.
unconfirmed: Exact AI cost per conversation (varies with model and token use; ~$0.20 is Richpanel's own estimate)
apps.notes: Our ~$0.24 per conversation at monthly rates scales Richpanel's ~$0.20 estimate by $0.60/$0.50. It's an approximation.
apps.ai_short: Token meter, ~$0.20–0.24 per AI conversation, $200/mo minimum, plus seats

apps.name: Re:amaze
apps.summary: Helpdesk billed per team member, with a small AI-resolution allowance per user.
apps.ai_billing: Re:amaze AI Agent: 5 (Basic), 10 (Pro) or 20 (Plus) resolutions per user per month included, then $0.85 per resolution.

plans.name: Starter
plans.includes: Flat rate, unlimited team members, 500 responded conversations/mo. No AI Agent (no AI resolutions)

apps.free_alt: Shopify Inbox is free for chat-only needs.
apps.notes: Re:amaze support confirmed by email on 2026-10-18 that the Starter plan does not include the AI Agent, and that the $29/user Basic price and $0.85 per extra resolution are correct.
apps.ai_short: $0.85 per resolution after small per-user allowance, plus seats

apps.name: Freshdesk (Freddy AI Agent)
apps.summary: Seat-based helpdesk. The Freddy AI Agent is billed in session packs after a one-time free allowance.
apps.ai_billing: $49 per 100 AI Agent sessions. A session is one interaction with the AI agent (for email, a 72-hour window). The first 500 sessions are free, once per account.

plans.name: Pro
plans.includes: Per agent. Freddy Copilot available at $29/agent/mo

unconfirmed: Monthly-billing seat prices (we captured annual-billing prices only)
apps.notes: Our estimates use the annual-billing seat price, so monthly billing will cost more. The one-time 500 free sessions are left out.

apps.name: Zipchat
apps.summary: AI agent for ecommerce chat, email and WhatsApp, priced by AI replies per month. It's an AI layer, not a full helpdesk.
apps.ai_billing: Per AI reply: every outbound AI message counts. Plans include a reply allowance, and extra packs cost $49 for 250 replies ($49 for 500 on Scale Plus).
apps.free_alt: Shopify Inbox's free AI agent overlaps for basic product Q&A.
apps.notes: The conversation counts are Zipchat's own approximations from reply allowances.
apps.ai_short: Per AI reply (plan allowances; $49 per 250 extra)

apps.name: Siena AI
apps.summary: AI agent platform for ecommerce brands, with a monthly platform fee plus a per-automated-ticket price.
apps.ai_billing: $0.90 per automated ticket, on top of a $750/mo platform fee. Support and implementation are priced separately (not public).
unconfirmed: Whether a helpdesk is also required for your setup
apps.notes: Siena sends a final quote on request.

apps.name: Chatty AI Chatbot & Live Chat
apps.summary: Shopify-native AI chatbot and live chat priced by AI conversations, with unlimited human conversations.
apps.ai_billing: Per AI conversation: plans include an allowance, and extra conversations cost $0.40 each.
apps.free_alt: Shopify Inbox's free AI agent overlaps for basic product Q&A.
apps.notes: The annual prices are the yearly price divided by 12 ($203.88, $707.88 and $2,039.88 per year).

apps.name: SB Helpdesk, Live Chat & FAQs (Helpcenter)
apps.summary: Low-cost Shopify helpdesk priced by tickets, with OpenAI-integrated FAQs. It isn't an autonomous AI agent.
apps.ai_billing: There's no separate AI fee. AI is used for FAQs (OpenAI-integrated) and the plans are priced by ticket.
apps.free_alt: Shopify Inbox is free for chat. Helpcenter adds ticketing and FAQs cheaply.
apps.notes: The annual prices are the yearly price divided by 12 ($59.99, $199.99 and $498.96 per year). Our estimates count every conversation as a ticket.
apps.ai_short: No AI agent fee; priced per ticket (AI FAQs)

changelog.title: Re:amaze: Starter plan confirmed without AI
items: Re:amaze support confirmed the flat $59 Starter plan doesn't include the AI Agent or any AI resolutions. AI resolutions come only with Basic (5/user), Pro (10/user) and Plus (20/user). Estimates were already based on Basic, so no cost figures changed.

changelog.title: New category: AI search & product recommendation apps (11 apps)
items: Recorded official prices for Shopify Search & Discovery (free), Searchanise, Boost AI Search & Discovery, Fast Simon, Doofinder, Algolia, Wiser, LimeSpot, Rebuy, Klevu/Searchspring (Athos Commerce) and Nosto.

Noted: Boost moved new installs to GMV-based pricing in October 2025. Its pricing page ($239 Convert / $399 Accelerate) and help centre example ($299 Convert / $699 Accelerate) show different figures, so medium and large estimates are 'Not public / check site'.
Noted: Doofinder's Shopify App Store prices ($61/$186/$436) are higher than its general web prices ($49/$149/$349).
Noted: Rebuy, Klevu/Athos and Nosto don't publish volume-based prices; Fast Simon and Wiser publish prices only up to 30,000 sessions and 2,000 orders respectively.

changelog.title: Tracker launched: baseline prices recorded for 13 AI support apps
items: Recorded official prices for Gorgias, Tidio (Lyro), Intercom Fin, Zendesk, HubSpot Service Hub, Shopify Inbox, Richpanel, Re:amaze, Freshdesk, Zipchat, Siena AI, Chatty and Helpcenter.
Noted: Zendesk's Shopify App Store listing still shows Suite Growth ($89/agent) and Suite Enterprise ($150/agent), which weren't on zendesk.com/pricing on this date.
Noted: Gorgias's pricing page markup contains two price sets. We use the detailed plan data (Basic $60, Pro $360, Advanced $900 monthly).
Noted: Intercom's Shopify listing shows monthly seat prices ($39/$99/$139) and intercom.com shows annual ($29/$85/$132).
